cc:Work.dc:title: Box - SlidingLidBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with rails for a sliding lid
* The sliding lid rests on the lower rails and is kept in place by the upper rails. * When using inner measurements, the height goes from bottom to lid, the lower rail is inside of the inner height. * The width of the rail can be adjusted, wider rails are more stable but make the opening smaller. * The horizontal margin makes the lid slightly narrower to prevent the lid from jamming. * The vertical margin makes the gap between the rails larger to let the lid slide more easily.
![Closed](static/samples/SlidingLidBox-2.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes SlidingLidBox --x=50 --y=50 --h=30 --thickness=4 --burn=0.1 '--output=T:\cameraprotectbox.svg' Command line short: boxes SlidingLidBox --x=50 --y=50 --h=30 --thickness=4 '--output=T:\cameraprotectbox.svg'
